observations: Photo 0: A black monitor partially wrapped in plastic, placed in an open cardboard box with foam inserts. The monitor is upright, showing its side profile. The background includes a bed with a white quilted cover and a dark curtain with gold patterns.

Photo 1: Top-down view of the open box showing foam inserts with circular cutouts. Two circular black components (likely stand parts) wrapped in plastic are visible, along with a small white label or sticker with text and a barcode. The box appears to be new or unused.

Photo 2: Top-down view of the monitor lying flat in the box, still partially wrapped. The screen is off, reflecting light. The bezel is thin and black. The box is open, resting on a white quilted surface (likely a bed).
